content: CSS Container Queries (size) are Baseline 'Widely available' since February 2023 — supported in Chrome/Edge 105+, Firefox 110+, Safari 16+, Opera 91+, Samsung Internet 20+ (~90% global support). Safe default choice in 2026 for responsive component layout (e.g. board scaling on different viewport widths) without JS. Note: container query *units* (cqw/cqh etc.) are not yet Baseline everywhere, though widely supported — verify if used.
